== Biography ==
'''Mary Glasgow''' was born on 13 Apr 1745 and baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 21 Apr 1745. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4165|George Glasgow]] and her mother as Margt.<ref name="FMP1" /> The register records both dates; Irvine is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.

Mary Glasgow was one of the children recorded to George Glasgow in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4121|Isabel]] (1741), [[Glasgow-4103|Magdalen]] (1743).
